headline: Let's build your product
intro: I'm a freelance full-stack developer. I take products from idea to launch on my own: web apps, mobile apps, APIs and the admin tools behind them. Tell me what you need and I'll reply within 24 hours.

process.title: Discovery call
process.description: A short call to understand the problem, your users and what success looks like.

process.title: Scope & quote
process.description: A written list of features, a timeline and a fixed price or a monthly plan.

process.title: Build with weekly demos
process.description: You see working software every week and can steer it early.

process.title: Launch
process.description: Deployment, domain and handover, with your data and code in your hands.

process.title: Support
process.description: Bug fixes after launch, and ongoing development if you need it.

whatsappMessage: Hi Varun, I saw your portfolio and want to discuss a project.
